newsitem.title: UK: BA Cargo ups ex-UK air cargo rates March 17.
newsitem.headline: BA Cargo ups ex-UK air cargo rates March 17.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo division is raising ex-UK air cargo rates from March 17, a BA Cargo spokesman told Reuters.
Rates to South America and West Africa will rise by 10 percent.
Rates to Japan, Asia, India, Australia and the Middle East will be increased by seven percent.
A five percent rise will apply for to the U.S. and Africa --apart from West Africa, South Africa and Kenya, he said.
There is no change in rates to Canada, Europe, South Africa and Kenya, he added. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
